selection.rules: Grid: 50 thresholds = np.quantile(values, np.linspace(0, 1, 50)), values = the statistic pooled over all validation questions of the benchmark set (ok questions only) and loops 1..3 (deployable_kl: D over its 3 columns); exact repeated thresholds are removed keeping order. Qualified point: macro validation loss <= 1.0 percentage point (+1e-12). Selection among qualified points: maximize macro validation saving; ties (1e-12) broken by smaller macro validation loss; remaining ties broken by the most conservative threshold (confidence, native_gate: largest; entropy, deployable_kl: smallest). A baseline with no qualified point is not qualified. fixed-k has one point each. Macro = unweighted mean over benchmarks. Thresholded policies halt at the earliest loop t in {1,2,3} whose rule fires, else run to loop 4. deployable_kl pays for loop t+1 and answers with loop t+1.
